objs.name: document
objs.description: A controlled information object managed through its lifecycle including creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving. Represents policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, etc.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g., policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction)

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the document in the document pyramid (Level 1-4)

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The descriptive title of the document

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation used in the document name (e.g., RL for guideline)

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client 4-digit consecutive number per document type

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the document within the status network (e.g., editing, released, out of force)

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document version is valid, set upon release

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Calculated expiry date based on Valid From plus period of extended validity

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time period for validity checks, default 3 years

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which invalidated documents are retained before physical deletion, default 10 years

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Areas of validity or relevant companies for the document

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents, master data, IT applications, processes, organizational units, or risks

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications relevant to the document

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational areas to which the document applies

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specifies in which clients the document is visible in a multi-client system

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document attached to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document. Changes to attachments trigger a new version of the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the attachment within the release process

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary document attached to a main document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly via property switches. Changes do not affect the main document version.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Whether the additional information has been published via property switches

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal to change an existing document, created by users with author rights. Does not affect the document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g., created, scheduled, completed)

attributes.name: editing_notes
attributes.description: Documentation of the author's processing of the change proposal

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend or revise the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the validity extension request

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a released document and archive it, created when a document has no additional validity and must be withdrawn from circulation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the override request

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate an invalidated (archived) document, created exclusively by the Business Admin group.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reactivation request

objs.name: author
objs.description: A person assigned as the primary responsible creator and editor of a document, who signs the creation step in the release workflow.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: A person assigned additional write permissions on a document who can initiate the release process but does not sign the creation step.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A person responsible for checking document content according to technical and/or formal aspects during the review step of the release workflow.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A person responsible for approving a document for distribution to readers and deciding whether it may be published.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A person who translates released document content into another language but cannot create new objects independently.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A person or user who can only view approved documents and confirm acknowledgement when required.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A defined group of users used to assign read or change authorizations and distribution to documents.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Type of user group (e.g., Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin)

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A configuration of user groups and persons assigned to a document for notification upon release, supporting email distribution and acknowledgement distribution.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email or for acknowledgement

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: An automated process instance that supports the release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, or translation approval of a document.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (e.g., release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, translation)

attributes.name: current_step
attributes.description: The current step in the workflow process

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature applied by workflow participants to confirm completion of their workflow task, documented per released version.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Person who applied the signature

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the signature was applied

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata printing.

attributes.name: template_name
attributes.description: Name of the document template

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: File format of the template (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

objs.name: report
objs.description: An evaluation report providing filtered information about documents based on selection parameters and criteria.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Type of report (e.g., Status Report, Search, Acknowledgement Status)

attributes.name: role_target
attributes.description: Target role for the report (Reader or Author)

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of the corresponding document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen during creation

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The template chosen during creation, if any

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: The metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated via the properties editing interface.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: The property category being edited (e.g., Master Data, Control)

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The document content is automatically converted to PDF format after saving, for web display.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to the document through user group or person-level assignment in the Control category.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Type of authorization assigned (read, write)

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or co-author.

evts.name: sign_creation_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the first workflow step confirming document creation with an electronic signature.

evts.name: perform_review
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and/or formal correctness and completes the task with an electronic signature.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Type of review performed (technical, formal)

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Outcome of the review (approved or rejected)

evts.name: perform_release
evts.description: A releaser approves or rejects the document for publication, completing the task with an electronic signature.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Outcome of the release decision (approved or rejected)

evts.name: reject_in_workflow
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, causing cancellation for all subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided for the rejection

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: The step at which rejection occurred (review or release)

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content changes, attribute changes, attachment changes, or change proposal scheduling.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: The reason for creating the new version (content change, attribute change, attachment change, change proposal)

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new attachment (controlled sub-document) is added to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is added to a document without affecting the document's version or release cycle.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, triggering the creation of a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the processing of a change proposal, marking it as completed and notifying the creator.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document's Valid Until date.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The validity extension request is processed through a workflow, resulting in extended validity, revision, or override.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Result of the validity extension process (extended, revision initiated, override initiated)

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document's validity is confirmed and the Valid Until date is updated by the default period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document is created by a user with write access.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override request is processed through a workflow to invalidate the document.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Outcome of the override workflow step (approved or rejected)

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force, its status is set to invalidated, all authorizations except archive group are revoked, and the archive duration begins.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: An archived document is physically deleted from the system after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A request to reactivate an invalidated document is created by the Business Admin group.

evts.name: process_reactivation
evts.description: The reactivation request is processed through a workflow by the initiator, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement of the document upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A reader confirms acknowledgement of a document via a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by a translator.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated document version is checked and released through a workflow, making it visible to readers in the corresponding language.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends an email notification to inform users about workflow tasks, status changes, or distribution events.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Type of notification (workflow task, status change, distribution, acknowledgement request)

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: An evaluation report is generated based on selected parameters and criteria for reader or author roles.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Type of report generated
